reason: PROP-016 Mech A halt — Priority 1b issue-proposal resolution (proposal-ISS-2946-resolution.json, findings EXP-658-baby-batch-1.json) patches CLAUDE.md with a file-map bullet documenting data/kill-shots.json lifecycle status. CLAUDE.md is a NEVER_PUSH file; stranded for operator manual application in own-clone-with-direct-push (no rescue path).
operator_action: 1) cd to your clone with direct push. 2) Apply each per_file_diff. 3) git add the listed all_modified_files (excluding this sentinel, already committed). 4) Commit + push. 5) Tombstone this sentinel per CLAUDE.md Tombstone convention. (Note: do NOT mv the file; the FUSE workspace does not support unlink, so a mv leaves the original re-resurrectable by workspace-sync round-trip. Tombstone-in-place + audit-trail copy is the convention.)

@@ -102,6 +102,7 @@ Every file that crosses the workspace↔git boundary has exactly one authoritati
 **git-owned** — `build.js publish` copies git → workspace. `workspace-sync` must NEVER push these; its `smart_copy` helper short-circuits if the destination is in the list.
 
 - `data/wins.json`, `data/sections.json`, `data/uncounted-failures.json`, `data/predictions.json` — canonical WIN/prose/failure/prediction data. Committed by the decider after build/test.
+- `data/kill-shots.json` — array of 7 KS-NNN kill-shot test entries (Sydney–Perth, Polaris, JFK–LHR, SAA, Eclipse 2026, NMP drift, stellar parallax). Schema documented in `monitor/prompts/reference/DATA-SCHEMAS.md` §kill-shots.json. **Status (verified 2026-07-09, ISS-2946):** this is live curmudgeon-review-target data (Phase 1 per-item review covers 'WINs, sections, prose, kill-shots' per `SCIENTIFIC-CONTEXT.md`) — NOT dead or superseded. However it is currently **disconnected from the build**: `build.js`/`build-scripts/*.js` do not read this file, and the `{{KS_TOTAL}}`/`{{KS_DECISIVE}}`/etc. placeholders documented in DATA-SCHEMAS.md do not exist anywhere in the codebase. The Kill Shots tab in `docs/index.html` (Part 5, Tests 1–7) is instead hand-authored static HTML that duplicates the same 7 tests. Spot-checked 2026-07-09: content is currently in sync (KS-001/002/006 verdicts and findings match Test 1/2/6 prose). Because the two copies are not build-linked, they can drift silently — a future edit to one won't propagate to the other. Treat `data/kill-shots.json` as the analytical source-of-record for curmudgeon review purposes; treat `docs/index.html` Part 5 as the current presentation source-of-record until/unless the build wiring described in DATA-SCHEMAS.md is implemented (untracked scope — not part of this BAU item).
 - `docs/index.html` — generated by `build.js`; regenerated on every publish.
 - `docs/llms.txt`, `docs/sitemap.xml`, `docs/robots.txt` — machine-readable layer. Social drafts updates to `monitor/social/drafts/`; decider commits to `docs/`.
 - `build-scripts/generate-html.js`, `build-scripts/generate-pdf.js`, `build-scripts/digest-reviews.js`, `build-scripts/fix-json-quotes.js`, `build-scripts/archive-old-reports.js` — infrastructure.
